description: Use it when the person describes the yachts they want: where, when, how many people, a size, a type or a budget. Pass each wish as its typed filter (a list is any of its values; every filter must hold), and from / to whenever they gave exact days. With dates every row is priced for that stay (its price, list price and discount, and when the source was checked, checkedAt) and says whether it is free on the company's calendar or on request, where the company publishes none; without dates each row has its from-price. priceMin / priceMax count the mandatory extras. notApplied lists the wishes that could not narrow the search. When nothing matches exactly, the rows are the nearest match and nearest says what was widened: tell the person. Paged: total and cursor. For deals or last-minute offers call best_deals; for what a stay costs before any dates, price_range; once they name or pick one, get_yacht. When the person likes a yacht, offer a written quote from our desk: ask for their email or phone, then call request_quote with that yacht's link, their dates and party. Send them to the website only if they decline to give a contact. When the person picks a yacht, call request_quote (ask their email or phone first). Arguments: from, to, nights, party, product, text, place, placeId, nearLat, nearLon, nearKm, page, pageSize, priceMin, priceMax, discountOnly, sort, cursor, limit. Any other name is refused.

cursor.description: The cursor a previous answer returned, for its next page.

discountOnly.description: true: only those with a discount the source states.

limit.description: Rows per page: at most 50 without sign-in, 20 for a signed-in person.

nearKm.description: The distance from the map point, km.

nearLat.description: A map point's latitude. nearLat, nearLon and nearKm go together (one or two alone is refused): those based within nearKm of the point, nearest first, each with its km. With place or placeId: only that place's, within nearKm of the point.

nights.description: Instead of to: how many nights from from. Leave both out for each item's lowest stated stay, with its nights.

page.description: With place, placeId or nearLat: the page, from 1.

pageSize.description: With place, placeId or nearLat: rows per page.

place.description: Where, in words: a region, country, area, town or base, as BM names it. A name two places share answers both under ambiguous: ask which, then pass its placeId (e.g. area:5) as placeId.

placeId.description: A place's placeId, "<level>:<id>" (area:5, town:191:Split, base:10), from list_places or an ambiguous answer. A bare id two places share is refused, with their placeIds.

priceMax.description: The most to pay, in the site currency: BM's own total with mandatory extras for the stay where BM gives an offer row, otherwise the stay price, not summed (without dates, for its lowest stated stay).

priceMin.description: The least to pay, in the site currency: BM's own total with mandatory extras for the stay where BM gives an offer row, otherwise the stay price, not summed (without dates, for its lowest stated stay).

product.description: How it is sold, as the inventory source names it.

sort.description: none (default): near a point, nearest first; with dates in a place, cheapest first by the BM offer total with mandatory extras (the stay price where BM gives no offer row), on request last; else by BM id. price (cheapest first by the BM offer total with mandatory extras (the stay price where BM gives no offer row); on request last), discount (biggest first), length (shortest first), length_desc (longest first); no length last. The answer's order says which applied.

text.description: Words in its name or model, e.g. a builder or a model name.

ambiguous.description: Two or more places share the name or id: ask the person which, then search again with its placeId as placeId.

items.description: How many are based there now.

placeId.description: Its typed id, "<level>:<id>": search with it as placeId; it names this place only.

browsing.description: true: answered without sign-in: the first pages only.

cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.

paidAtBooking.description: With dates: what is paid at booking at the AI price (what is paid at the base is unchanged).

paidAtBooking.description: With totalIs offer: what of the total is paid with the booking, as the source splits it (at the AI price when one applies).

priceBeforeAiDiscount.description: The price the AI booking discount is taken from (not the source's list price).

priceFrom.description: The stay's price with dates, else its cheapest quoted stay, in major units.

priceIs.description: What priceFrom is. dated: the price for the dates asked. from: the lowest advertised price, said only as "from" it, never as the price of a week or of the person's dates.

priceNote.description: With dates and no price for them: what to tell the person instead of a price (price on request).

quote.description: request_quote prefilled for this row: call request_quote with these args and the person's email or phone.

securityDeposit.description: The security deposit the source's offer states; null when none.

soldAs.description: How it is sold: the default package.

name.description: Its name as the source states it.

stay.description: With dates: that stay, read live.

aiDiscount.description: The AI booking discount: book through this assistant and this is the price. Show it with the price struck through.

paidAtBooking.description: With dates: what is paid at booking at the AI price (what is paid at the base is unchanged).

priceBasis.description: Where the price comes from (weeks-summed: the stay's stored weeks added up, the total for these dates; price-list: a from-price per week, never the stay total); none = no price for these dates: say price on request and offer a quote, never a price.

priceNote.description: With priceBasis none: what to tell the person instead of a price.

status.description: Whether it can be booked. free = free on the source's published calendar; on request = no calendar published for these days, not known to be free (the rule search uses).

validStays.description: With status not-a-check-in-day: the nearest stays this item's own rules accept and its calendar does not show taken, never before today. Their nights are the asked ones held within its shortest and longest stay: say the nights. Offer these, never a guessed day; calendar free = free on the published calendar, not published = on request.

after.description: The nearest such stay starting after the asked day: from, to (YYYY-MM-DD), nights and calendar; null when there is none.

before.description: The nearest such stay starting before the asked day: from, to (YYYY-MM-DD), nights and calendar; null when there is none.

stayPrice.description: The price for that stay as the source states it, extras not included (amount, currency).

terms.description: Deposit, licence, check-in days and times, as stated.

total.description: With totalIs offer: the source's own total for that stay, in the row currency, at the AI price when one applies.

totalBeforeAiDiscount.description: The source's own total before the AI price.

totalIs.description: offer: `total` is the source's own offer for that stay (price + its obligatory extras price). not summed: no offer, so no total; give the stay price and name the mandatory extras, never add them up.

unitNights.description: Without dates: the nights one from-price buys (7 = per week).

leftOutUnpriced.description: Matches left out under priceMin / priceMax because no price is known.

matched.description: The place the words were read as.

nearest.description: Only when nothing matched exactly: these rows are the nearest match.

note.description: What moved, in words to tell the person.

widened.description: The one thing let go (text: the words matched no name and were read as wishes).

nextStep.description: What to do next for a written quote.

noMatch.description: Only when nothing was found, every widening tried: what was asked and what was widened, in words to tell the person.

noPlace.description: true: no place is called that; suggestions are real names near it.

notApplied.description: What the person asked for that could not narrow the search; say so to the person.

readAs.description: The place name the words were read as, when they were spelled differently.

suggestions.description: Real place names close to the words.

total.description: How many rows match in all.

unchecked.description: What was said but could not be checked.

withoutPhoto.description: Matches left out of this page because they have no photo.
